qc.label_under_test: the Latinate word start ' aff' as its own token (aff-luence, aff-able, aff-ords) and the related 'affirmative', plus 'ia' in 'in absentia'

neighbours.label: A short list of specific word pieces, not word fragments in general: ' aff' split off a word (affluence, affix), 'ia' in absentia/Setia, 'iss' in amiss, 'ative' in formative, and ' utter(ly)'
fire: The town's sudden affluence was obvious from the new marble fountains along the main street.
To form the plural, attach the correct affix to the end of the root word.
The court tried the fugitive in absentia after he failed to appear for the third time.
We stopped for lunch in Setia before driving on to the coast.
She sensed something was amiss the moment she opened the front door.
Those formative years on the farm shaped how he thought about work.
The film was an utter disaster from the opening scene to the credits.
By the end of the marathon she was utterly exhausted and could barely stand.
quiet: The town's sudden wealth was obvious from the new marble fountains along the main street.
To form the plural, attach the correct ending to the back of the root word.
The court tried the fugitive without him present after he failed to appear for the third time.
We stopped for lunch in Lisbon before driving on to the coast.
She sensed something was wrong the moment she opened the front door.
Those early years on the farm shaped how he thought about work.
The film was a complete disaster from the opening scene to the credits.
By the end of the marathon she was totally exhausted and could barely stand.

predictions: Expect 7-8/8 fire (earlier probes put these pieces at 0.4-1.0 of pole max), near misses near 0; ' present' in the near miss 'without him present' may leak a little.
